suggestions.title: Girokonto Klassik fee rising — worth comparing accounts
suggestions.body: Musterbank plans to raise your Girokonto Klassik fee from €4.90 to €6.90 a month starting 1 December 2026. Before deciding on the consent request, it could be worth comparing other current account offers.
suggestions.rationale: The fee-increase letter and the Girokonto Klassik contract show the monthly fee rising from €4.90 to €6.90.

suggestions.title: MusterStrom Flex minimum term ended — compare energy tariffs
suggestions.body: Your MusterStrom Flex electricity contract's minimum term ended on 30 Sep 2026, so you can now switch with one month's notice. It may be worth comparing tariffs against the current €48.00 monthly cost.
suggestions.rationale: The contract's rules_summary shows the minimum term has ended and lists a monthly cost of €48.00.

suggestions.title: Check if your semester fee already includes a transport ticket
suggestions.body: You're paying €63.00 a month for a separate Deutschlandticket while also owing your semester fee to Hochschule Musterstadt. Many German semester fees bundle a subsidized transport ticket, so it's worth checking whether you already have one included.
suggestions.rationale: The semester fee item and the Deutschlandticket contract both cover transport costs and could overlap.

suggestions.title: Link your Muster BKK health insurance to a contract
suggestions.body: The recent contribution notice from Muster BKK couldn't be matched to an existing contract in your records. Adding it will make it easier to track future contribution changes.
suggestions.rationale: The health insurance letter carries a warning that it couldn't be matched to a contract.

suggestions.title: Add your university enrollment as a tracked contract
suggestions.body: Your semester documents from Hochschule Musterstadt weren't matched to any contract in your records. Adding it will help you keep future semester fees and deadlines organised.
suggestions.rationale: The semester fee letter carries a warning that it couldn't be matched to a contract.

suggestions.title: Confirm you haven't paid the TechMarkt invoice twice
suggestions.body: TechMarkt's reminder letter notes that the original €89.99 invoice is still open and asks that you pay the amount only once. Worth checking which of the two you've actually settled before paying the €94.99 reminder.
suggestions.rationale: The reminder letter explicitly warns that the original invoice and the reminder refer to the same payment.
